decisions.quote:
# From https://github.com/Motivation-and-Behaviour/screen_umbrella/blob/7ad51ffa696ed0476a3902c75dd391299d9533a9/R/run_metaanalysis.R#L15
  meta_out <- rma(
    data = df,
    measure = "COR",
    ri = r_estimate,
    ni = study_n,
    slab = study_name
  )

  dfz <- combine_data(r = df$r_estimate, n = df$study_n, study_names = df$study_name, transformation = "fishers_z")

  naive_est <- z2r(meta_out$b)
decisions.location: Author-linked R/analysis.R: original uncorrected rma baseline before PET-PEESE; full report Abstract/Methods/Table1
decisions.reason: The report plus newly retrieved author-linked complete analysis code have received a NEW sanitized blind coding and independent source/hash/schema/quote checks. Contrary to a not-checked label, the code explicitly runs the original uncorrected rma model on the eight highlighted effect IDs before PET-PEESE and builds the reported table r column from that baseline. Thus numerical reproduction is within the supplied analysis plan; the old generic error-inspection inference is unnecessary. However, code alone does not document which results were executed at report time or independently establish agreement with the original numbers. The paper says no errors were found but prints no explicit original-number recovery statement; no central execution log/output/data comparison is supplied here. Current repository version cannot be assumed identical to report-time execution. New blind coding independently retains cannot_be_determined. This final actual numerical-recovery/version-evidence limit is not an unexamined link or an administrative deferral. No author data or analysis was executed by this audit.
